Reply with a single ```js code block containing only the function, exported as `export function merge`.

proof.test: import { merge } from './answer.mjs'; const r = merge([{start:1,end:3},{start:8,end:10}], [{start:2,end:6},{start:10,end:12},{start:15,end:18}]); const s = JSON.stringify(r); if (s !== JSON.stringify([{start:1,end:6},{start:8,end:12},{start:15,end:18}])) { console.error('got ' + s); process.exit(1); } const e = merge([], []); if (JSON.stringify(e) !== '[]') process.exit(1);
